content.thinking:
Interesting: most packets got "queue" because pending_capacity=512 was saturated quickly (service times up to 10^6 and packet times increase slowly, so lanes are backlogged). This limits jobs to 512. To stress the CNN, I need many jobs: use small service times (svcmax small) so jobs complete quickly, and larger pcap.

Let me set svcmax=100 so lanes free up quickly → most packets export → ~19000 jobs. Then measure time.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/stress.py nconn=64 svcmax=50 > tmp/big3.json && time python3 submission/main.py < tmp/big3.json > tmp/big3.out; echo "exit=$?"; ls -l tmp/big3.out; python3 -c "
import json,collections; d=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/big3.out'));
print('packets',len(d['packets']),'jobs',len(d['jobs']))
print(collections.Counter(p['decision'] for p in d['packets']))
print(collections.Counter(j['status'] for j in d['jobs']))
"
